description: Real-time server pings to keep all connections open

subscription_request.jwt: optional - Bearer token for authenticated requests

notes: Heartbeats are sent every second and include a counter to verify no messages were missed. Subscribe to heartbeats alongside other channels to ensure all subscriptions stay open when updates are sparse, especially useful for illiquid pairs.
use_case: Keep WebSocket connections alive during periods of inactivity
recommended_frequency: Always enabled when subscribing to other channels
